# noozle_query (Data Source)

Reads a saved Noozle query by ID.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) Unique identifier of the query.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the query was created.
- `description` (String) Optional note explaining the query purpose.
- `full_expression` (String) Serialized query expression DSL string.
- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether the saved query is active.
- `name` (String) Name presented for the saved query.
- `tags` (List of String) Labels assigned to the query.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp of the most recent update.
